notes: **2026-09-01** — (branch `chore/validate-lessons`, off master `80bced16`; tooling only, no app code) — **LESSONS-REGISTER INTEGRITY AS A GATE.** New `scripts/validate-lessons.mjs` + `npm run validate-lessons`, wired as **step 2 of `npm run verify`** beside the lockfile gate (both are cheap file-only checks that must fail before turbo spends minutes). It closes the one class a merge cannot: `_meta.json`s `activeCount`/`archivedCount`/`nextId` are counts OF the files beside them, so when two branches each append an entry `LESSONS.md` merges CLEANLY — different `##` sections, no textual conflict — while BOTH sides' counts are individually correct and the total is neither. Observed live 2026-09-01: master 28, #588 +2 declaring 30, #590 +2 declaring 30, merged file 32. The only reason anyone looked is that `_meta.json` happened to conflict on adjacent lines. Six fatal classes: COUNT MISMATCH · DUPLICATE ID (within a file and ACROSS both — a compaction must MOVE an entry, not copy it) · NEXTID (must exceed the max id in EITHER file; an archived id is retired, never reissued, because the citation pointing at it still resolves) · **DANGLING REF** (a `[[L-0xx]]` naming no existing entry — the check that makes ids safely immutable, since renumbering breaks citations in the code map, the `new-feature` skill and CLAUDE.md silently) · CONFLICT MARKER · OVER CAP. Id-sequence gaps are deliberately NOT findings — a gap is normally an id reserved by an unmerged branch, and treating it as free is the exact mistake the register keeps paying for. All six classes mutation-proven to exit 1 against scratch copies, each with a self-explaining message naming the offending value. ⚠️ **The caps moved from constants into `_meta.json` (`maxEntries`/`maxBytes`)** so an owner ruling is a one-field edit rather than a code change — and they currently CONTRADICT each other: at the measured ~0.92 KB/entry the 40-entry cap implies ~37 KB against the 25 KB ceiling, so size really permits ~27 entries and the entry cap is unreachable. The gate reports that on every run rather than silently enforcing the stricter. ⚠️ **Master sits at 24.9/25.0 KB — 71 bytes of headroom, i.e. the NEXT entry anyone writes trips this gate**; that is the cap working, and the ruling it forces is the owner's. No lessons entry filed: this is a chore, not a fix — and adding one would itself breach the cap it enforces. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory).
